user.title: Connect to Ho-Smart / eMACROS receiver
user.description: Enter the receiver address and your My Hosmart app credentials. Home Assistant uses the account during setup to retrieve the receiver's local-control key and cloud identity. Your My Hosmart email and password are not saved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Ho-Smart / eMACROS receiver on the local network.
error.invalid_cloud_auth: The My Hosmart email or password was not accepted.
error.cloud_error: Could not communicate with the My Hosmart service.
error.no_devices: The My Hosmart account did not return any receivers.
error.cannot_match_device: The account devices could not be matched to this receiver. Verify the receiver IP address.

abort.already_configured: This Ho-Smart / eMACROS receiver is already configured.

init.title: Connection mode
init.description: Choose how this receiver connects to Home Assistant. Nighttime quiet hours, individual channel schedules, and arm/disarm switches are on the receiver's device page under Configuration; you do not need Configure for everyday settings.

cloud_credentials.title: Enable My Hosmart cloud alarms
cloud_credentials.description: This existing entry was created before cloud alarm support. Enter your My Hosmart app credentials once so Home Assistant can retrieve the account user ID. The email, password and access token are not stored.

error.cannot_match_device: This My Hosmart account does not contain the receiver already configured in Home Assistant.
error.quiet_requires_local: Quiet hours require Local or Hybrid mode to communicate with this receiver.
